structured_output.summary: Single PR: add stream_detached and stream_logs to reverse_proxy, per-upstream stream tracking so reloads close only streams whose upstream was removed, hijack-safe response writers (recorder/encode/intercept), stream metrics and close logs, with unit and integration tests. Docs are the JSON struct-field doc comments and Caddyfile syntax comments, since the repo has no separate docs tree.

intents.rationale: No detached mode exists. Add StreamDetached on Handler. Track upgraded streams in a registry that outlives the handler's Cleanup, keyed by upstream dial address. On Cleanup in detached mode, close only streams whose upstream is absent from the new config; otherwise leave them running.
Cleanup already closes registered connections, immediately or after StreamCloseDelay. The new code must leave this path untouched when stream_detached is unset. Integration tests pin it.
Add a StreamLogs struct with SkipHandshake (Caddyfile and JSON). When set, the upgrade handshake request is excluded from the access log.

Emit a stream-close log on the access logger (logger_name access) with duration, bytes and result. The level is configurable via stream_logs, default DEBUG. Today only a plain debug 'connection closed' log is written on the handler logger.

The proxy currently calls rw.WriteHeader before hijacking, and the recorder wraps the hijacked conn in hijackedConn. Mark the writers as hijacked so later WriteHeader, Write and Flush are no-ops. Write the 101 straight on the raw conn as the final response, and copy bytes on the raw conn, not the recorder wrapper.

encode and intercept with handle_response must pass upgrades through. encode's responseWriter must not compress or write after a 101 or a hijack. intercept must not buffer or replace a 101. Access logging must not write after hijack.

Extended CONNECT over h2 uses h2ReadWriteCloser on the response writer. Keep it working with the new stream registry, accounting and hijack guards, and make HTTP/1.1 upgrades work in detached mode. Integration tests verify both.

Add Prometheus metrics in metrics.go: active streams gauge, closed counter by result, duration histogram, and bytes to/from backend counters. Account each stream exactly once via a sync.Once in the stream close path.
Add stream_detached and a stream_logs { skip_handshake; level } block to the Caddyfile unmarshaler and the JSON struct, with doc comments. Add an adapt test.

Add integration tests with a real server and real clients (raw TCP upgrade and h2 extended CONNECT). Cover reload survival and closure in detached and default modes, removed-upstream closure, upgrades through encode and intercept, and detached streams with access logging.
Add unit tests for the stream registry, the metrics accounting, the Caddyfile parsing, and the hijack-guarded response writers.

criteria.text: With stream_detached set, an upgraded stream stays open and keeps echoing after a config reload that keeps its upstream. Test: TestStreamDetachedSurvivesReload.
With stream_detached set, a reload that removes the stream's upstream closes that stream, and streams on retained upstreams stay open. Test: TestStreamDetachedClosesRemovedUpstream.
With stream_detached unset, a reload closes the upgraded stream, honouring stream_close_delay (immediately when 0, after the delay otherwise). Test: TestStreamDefaultClosedOnReload.
stream_logs skip_handshake suppresses the access log entry for the upgrade handshake; the default logs it. Test: TestStreamLogsSkipHandshake.
A stream close entry appears under logger_name access at the configured level, DEBUG by default. Test: TestStreamCloseLogAccessLogger.

After Hijack, the response recorder and encode writers ignore WriteHeader, Write and Flush; the 101 is written once to the raw conn; proxy copying uses the raw conn. Test: TestResponseRecorderNoWriteAfterHijack.
WebSocket-style upgrades succeed and echo through encode, and through intercept with handle_response, with access logging enabled. Test: TestUpgradeThroughEncodeAndIntercept.
An h2 extended CONNECT stream works end to end, and an HTTP/1.1 upgrade works in detached mode. Test: TestExtendedConnectH2 and TestStreamDetachedHTTP11Upgrade.
Metrics record active streams, closed-by-result, duration and bytes to/from the backend, each stream counted exactly once even with concurrent close paths. Test: TestStreamMetricsAccountedOnce.

The Caddyfile parses stream_detached and stream_logs { skip_handshake; level } into the expected JSON; invalid input errors. Test: the reverse_proxy_stream_detached.caddyfiletest adapt test and TestStreamOptionsCaddyfile.
The new JSON fields and Caddyfile syntax are documented in struct doc comments and the UnmarshalCaddyfile syntax comment.
Integration tests exist in caddytest/integration using a real server and real clients, covering the scenarios listed in the intent.
Unit tests accompany each changed package: reverseproxy (registry, metrics, caddyfile) and caddyhttp (hijack guard).

tasks.summary: Order: (1) add the config fields (StreamDetached, StreamLogs) and the Caddyfile and JSON parsing; (2) add the hijack-safety guards in the response recorder, encode, intercept and access logging; (3) add the per-upstream stream registry, detached Cleanup semantics, stream close accounting and the access-logger close log in handleUpgradeResponse; (4) add the metrics; (5) write the unit tests, the adapt test and the integration tests. The default close path (closeConnections, cleanupConnections, stream_close_delay) must not change when stream_detached is unset.
